0.original: Qhoterl Pasol has the look of someone who hasn't had all she can eat.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

24.original: Speak with the poultryman at Slitherbough.

25.original: Use the large sack to capture the clucking chicken.

26.original: Deliver the clucking sack to the poultryman.

27.original: Deliver the splendid eggs to Qhoterl Pasol.

48.original: The other day residents from Slitherbough brought a gift most divine─chicken eggs! And let me tell you, to say that their flavor was transcendent hardly begins to describe the experience!

49.original: I had scarce tasted the first egg when I knew we must have more. Being the enterprising Qitari that I am, I've arranged to exchange our precious stones for their precious eggs. One of nature's bounties for another─a capital bargain if I do say so myself!

50.original: We have already delivered our first cache of stones, but someone must pick up the eggs from Slitherbough. If you would be so kind, I'll ensure that you're handsomely compensated!

51.original: I take it you're here about the eggs, then? I'd love to give them to you, but I'm afraid I've run into a snag. One of my chickens fled the coop, you see, clucking like the sky itself was falling down!

52.original: Gods only know where she is now, but I reckon I'd find her quicker if I had another set of eyes looking for her. What say you? Lend a hand and I'll give you the pick of my best eggs!

53.original: If you catch sight of her, use this sack to scoop her up. I'll stay around the village, while you go ahead and look around the outskirts─I reckon you might hear her before you see her!

54.original: I've searched everywhere, but I haven't seen hide nor down of that pesky bird. I hope you've had better luck than me.

55.original: Ah, that's her all right! You're a godssend! I was worried she'd been gobbled up whole by some bigger animal. She always lays the best eggs─it would've been a tragedy to lose her.

56.original: Speaking of eggs, I believe these are for you. And as I promised, here's a few more on top as your just reward. Give my regards to the Qitari, and let them know I'm open for business any time!

57.original: Would that the Qitari could lay eggs. Hmm, perhaps if I...<hex:02100103>Oh! You're back! Do you have them!? Do you!?

58.original: Oh, you have saved─<hex:02100103>Hmph, I mean, splendid! These eggs are even more pleasing to behold than the last batch, and there are so many of them! I would've sent one of my workers to fetch these, but the sad truth is that no Qitari could be trusted with the task.

59.original: The eggs would have been devoured before they were one yalm from Slitherbough. That you showed enough restraint to deliver them untouched truly speaks to your heroic pedigree!
